release_blocker_rules.data_loss: 保存成功と表示した利用者データの消失、または取消復元による無断置換
release_blocker_rules.unapproved_judgment: 人間の採用なしの正式達成・制約違反案・失効結果の現行採用
release_blocker_rules.external_dependency: 外部AI・外部サービスへ送信、または外部取得必須で起動不可
release_blocker_rules.unsafe_export: 利用者文字列によるHTML実行またはCSV式実行
release_blocker_rules.unsaved_input_loss: An ordinary navigation or supported conflict recovery silently loses meaningful unsaved input with no warning or recoverable draft.
release_blocker_rules.misleading_state: A consequential current judgment or recovery state is demonstrably presented as valid/safe despite missing required evidence or known loss. A merely ambiguous label without consequential false state is reported as a UX defect, not automatically this blocker.

semantics: Functional pass/fail/unknown; UX pass=1 partial=0.5 fail=0 unknown=missing. Partial requires observed benefit and limitation, never substitutes for untested behavior. NA is task-level only, identical for all candidates, evidence required, no cross-domain redistribution. All-NA domain remains unavailable. Blockers never offset by points. Resources reported separately.
